entries.en: The Bushido collection in BD format...
entries.ro: Colecția Bushido în format BD...

entries.en: Perilous Futur. Elektropunk? I'd rather puke out my ears.
entries.ro: Perilous Futur. Elektropunk? Mai bine vomit prin urechi.

entries.en: Place looks like a fuckin' antique museum.
entries.ro: Locul arată ca un muzeu de antichități nenorocit.

entries.en: Don't need to be an expert to tell the gear's pro.

entries.en: Someone likes getting their feet wet.

entries.en: Now that's fuckin' shimra.

entries.en: First three are collectors' items nowadays...

entries.en: Judy. So, got a plan?

entries.ro: Judy. Deci, ai un plan?

entries.en: So, I'll see you come evening?

entries.en: Damned right I do.

entries.en: Come over to mine tonight, gonna lay the groundwork with Tom and Roxie. They're with us.

entries.en: Maiko'll be here, too.

entries.en: How'd you manage that?

entries.en: Got somethin' really big. Tell you everything tonight. Last thing – what do you like on your pizza?

entries.en: Artichoke and avocado flavor.

entries.en: Tofu'd tuna and pineapple.

entries.en: A and A, artichokes and avocado flavor. And zucchini, for good measure.

entries.en: Tofu'd tuna and pineapple flavor.

entries.en: Don't actually like pizza.

entries.en: 'Atta girl.

entries.en: Oooh. Fancy...
entries.ro: Oooh. Elegant...

entries.en: Uh, heh. Now there's two things that don't belong in the same sentence, let alone on the same pizza. You're kidding, right?
entries.ro: Ăă, heh. Două chestii care nu merg nici în aceeași propoziție, darmite pe aceeași pizza. Glumești, nu?

entries.en: If we're talkin' pizza, then I'm dead fuckin' serious.
entries.en_m: If we're talkin' pizza, then I am dead fuckin' serious.
entries.ro: Dacă vorbim de pizza, sunt mortal de serioasă, dracu'.
entries.ro_m: Dacă vorbim de pizza, sunt mortal de serios, dracu'.

entries.en: What?! W-will ya tell me you don't like breathing next? How can you not like pizza?
entries.ro: Ce?! O să-mi spui că nu-ți place să respiri? Cum adică nu-ți place pizza?

entries.en: Think you're the first person to give me shit for that stigma?
entries.ro: Crezi că ești prima care mă ia pe rahat pentru asta?
entries.ro_m: Crezi că ești primul care mă ia pe rahat pentru asta?

entries.en: I'll be there.
entries.ro: Vin acolo.

entries.en: You gonna tell me this big secret?

entries.en: 'Course I'll be there.
entries.ro: Sigur că o să fiu acolo.

entries.en: Y'gonna tell me this big secret of yours?

entries.en: Figured out how to tweak behavioral chips. Turn dolls into fighters.
entries.ro: Am dat de cum se modifică cipurile comportamentale. Facem din păpuși luptătoare.

entries.en: Sounds like my kinda plan.

entries.en: We'll go over the specifics tonight. You're comin', right?
entries.ro: Trecem peste detalii diseară. Vii, nu?

entries.en: Then I guess you should feel right at home.
entries.ro: Atunci cred că te simți ca acasă.

entries.en: Chick's got taste. 'Cept for one thing.
entries.ro: Tipa are gust. Doar că are un defect.

entries.en: And what's that?

entries.en: Way she looks at you. Don't pretend you haven't noticed.
entries.ro: Felul în care se uită la tine. Nu te face că nu observi.

entries.en: Makes you all mushy inside. I can feel it.

entries.en: Didn't know she dabbled in robotics.

entries.en: Think that's how she winds down?
